name: Trace Map
summary: A folder upload drawn as a circuit board: your real folder tree lights up trace by trace as it uploads
about: Trace Map reads a whole folder you choose or drop and lays it out as a circuit board, with copper traces for the tree, chips for folders and solder pads for files, each with its real size. Upload sends three files at a time; every finished file fires a spark up its trace, folder rings fill and their LEDs light, and when the last file lands the whole board glows. Folders fold open and shut, system files are skipped and every path is kept.
how: Press Choose folder, drop a folder on the board, or press Sample for a wedding album.
Fold any folder open or shut with its arrow; the top line counts files, folders and size.
Press Upload: three files go at once, sparks run up the traces and folder rings fill.
When every trace glows the summary shows the totals; press Upload again or pick another folder.
